    rays = set()

            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == color:
                    # The pair endpoints are (r,c) and (r+dr,c+dc).
                    back = 0
                    x, y = r, c
                    while 0 <= x - dr < h and 0 <= y - dc < w:
                        back += 1
                        x -= dr
                        y -= dc
                    forward = 0
                    x, y = rr, cc
                    while 0 <= x + dr < h and 0 <= y + dc < w:
                        forward += 1
                        x += dr
                        y += dc
                    if forward >= back:
                        start_r, start_c, step_r, step_c = rr, cc, dr, dc
                    else:
                        start_r, start_c, step_r, step_c = r, c, -dr, -dc
                    # Ray signature prevents duplicate processing of the same line.
                    rays.add((color, start_r, start_c, step_r, step_c))
    for color, r, c, dr, dc in rays:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
            out[r][c] = color
            r += dr
            c += dc
